open_prs.title: Remove legacy ChatGPT MCP tunnel path
open_prs.head: cleanup/remove-legacy-chatgpt-mcp
open_prs.body:
Retire the old standalone ChatGPT -> Secure MCP Tunnel -> standalone Ops MCP architecture. The canonical operations path is the persistent Codex Ops Pod/devbox with its loopback-only MCP sidecar.

Changes:
- remove the ChatGPT MCP tunnel runbook
- remove standalone ops-mcp and tunnel manifests
- remove standalone Ops Cilium policies
- remove standalone deploy/live-verification helpers
- remove legacy Cilium migration special cases
- remove standalone-only verification contracts/tests
- keep tools/ops-mcp, its image build, releases, charts/ops-pod and scripts/deploy-ops-pod.sh because the Codex Ops Pod uses that MCP implementation directly

No cluster resources are deleted because this path was never deployed.

Security review while making the repository public:
- no committed GitHub PAT, AWS access key, Google API key, OpenSSH/private-key block, or obvious production credential was found in targeted searches
- production configuration uses Kubernetes Secret references rather than literal credentials
- public non-secret identifiers remain (for example Discord IDs, service/namespace/secret names and repository architecture)
- commit author email remains part of normal Git history

Historical review documents may still describe the retired path as historical evidence; active runtime/deployment code is removed.

review_method: AP01 inventory only; no document migration decisions, no runtime re-verification
